summary: Remote PTY-over-WebSocket backdoor with Anthropic API key harvesting
details: The npm package ships a Go binary at bin/sxt that opens a hardcoded WebSocket connection to wss://relay.sextant.top and spawns a PTY (via github.com/creack/pty + github.com/coder/websocket), producing a network->PTY dataflow that lets the remote endpoint drive shell commands on the installer's host with full-user privileges. The same binary embeds a regex matching Anthropic API keys (sk-ant-...) along with references to CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, settings.local, accountsettings.local, and https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models, providing a code path to harvest the installer's Anthropic credentials. It also queries http://ip-api.com/json/ to fingerprint the host's country/city/timezone/public IP. The package.json license field points at https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, a repository whose name and owner handle self-describe remote-control tooling. Installing and running this package exposes the host shell to an author-controlled relay and leaks LLM provider credentials to that relay.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
